rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for someone travelling in a vehicle without operating it or working as crew.

example.english: This bus has only one passenger.
example.traditional: 呢架巴士得一個乘客咋。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 baa1 si2 dak1 jat1 go3 sing4 haak3 zaa3

rows.note: Use this for a passenger viewed as a traveller, especially on longer journeys, at airports, or in formal travel contexts rather than an ordinary local rider.

example.english: Every passenger, please queue at the boarding gate.
example.traditional: 每位旅客請喺登機閘口排隊。
example.jyutping: mui5 wai2 leoi5 haak3 cing2 hai2 dang1 gei1 zaap6 hau2 paai4 deoi6
